title: Lunar Legend Tsukihime
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a near-fatal childhood injury, Shiki Tohno can see 'death lines' on everything, which he can cut to destroy what they belong to; special glasses hold the vision back. Called home to his estranged family after his father's death, he kills a woman in a sudden fit, only for her to return alive: Arcueid, a vampire who asks him to be her bodyguard. The adaptation of Type-Moon's adult visual novel follows vampire hunts and the dark secrets of the Tohno family.
life_message: Facing one's buried past and protecting those one loves gives meaning even in a world shadowed by death.
